# Isaiah Chapter 47 -- The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full dynamic translation of all 15 verses in natural contemporary English]*

*Virgin daughter Babylon humbled; loss of children; astrologers cannot save; no deliverer*

---

## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

**Fall of Babylon:** Virgin daughter Babylon humbled; loss of children; astrologers cannot save; no deliverer. The key message for modern readers: "You felt secure in your wickedness; you said, No one sees me"

*-- PNEUMA*
